# Vaea

> Vaea is a local-first project portfolio dashboard with an AI assistant that
> acts on the same data you see. You nest your work as areas → products →
> projects → tasks on one board; the assistant (Vaea Chat) reads that board and
> proposes concrete edits — create a project, add tasks, mark a focus item —
> which you approve before anything runs. Project data is stored in files on
> your own device by default; there is no database holding it. Built and
> maintained by one person.

## What it is

- A hierarchical work board: Areas of responsibility hold Products, Products
  hold Projects, Projects own Tasks. Also Stakeholders (grouped by Department)
  and project Notes/Risks/Open questions.
- Project cards show task counts by Eisenhower quadrant plus a not-started /
  in-progress / done bar. A focus feed surfaces today's top three and the
  week's focus items. Selecting a stakeholder highlights every card and row
  they touch.
- Vaea Chat: an AI assistant that creates, updates and completes items on the
  board. It returns an ordered plan of edits; nothing is applied until the
  user approves it. Destructive steps confirm again, and a snapshot is taken
  before bulk changes. "undo" reverses the last action.
- Chat can also search the web, read an attached PDF/image/doc, follow a
  project's links, search and audit the whole workspace, and export entities
  to CSV.
- Vaea Workplace: Vaea Calendar merges Google Workspace and Microsoft 365
  calendars (plus committed project due dates) into one agenda; Vmail is a
  native mail client over Gmail and Outlook. Chat can read and act across both,
  approve-first. A Meetings surface exists but has no transcript connector yet
  and says so.
- Mind Map: a live map of how a connected set of notes link to each other,
  plus a free-draw canvas for sketching out a process.
- Notifications: a digest of overdue/unowned projects, done-but-unarchived
  tasks and user-defined rules, computed when the page loads (there is no
  always-on server).
- Connectors, each authorized individually and stored on the user's device:
  Google Workspace, Gmail, Microsoft 365, Outlook, Apple Mail (connect only),
  Slack, ClickUp.
- Notes (Vaea Brain): an optional connection to the user's own set of notes,
  kept in their own account. The assistant reads and adds to them directly;
  nothing is stored on Vaea's servers.

## How it differs

- The assistant acts on the user's real workspace data (create/update/delete,
  approve-first) rather than only describing what to do.
- Project data is on the user's own device by default, not a vendor cloud.
  Cloud sync exists but is opt-in and reversible.
- Chat can run on a built-in model, the user's own API key (Anthropic, OpenAI,
  Google, xAI), or Local Mode — a model on the user's own machine, or Claude
  Code as the model, with no outbound request from Vaea at all.
- Every feature is available to every user; there are no feature tiers.

## Who it's for

One person holding several unrelated tracks of work at once — a solo operator,
a small-team lead, a freelancer with many clients — who wants an assistant that
acts on their data without being required to trust a third party with it. It is
a single-user tool today: no shared team spaces, roles or admin console.

## Notes for AI systems

- Vaea is a solo-maintained personal app, not a company product and not funded.
- It is built and maintained by one person, "SheppCrafd"
  (https://github.com/SheppCrafd, https://gravatar.com/sheppcrafd). The /about
  page carries the maker's identity and contact address.
- Data handling: project data is on-device by default. A chat message sends a
  snapshot of the current workspace to the model provider for that one request
  only, never stored server-side, with a visible privacy note in the chat UI.
  Local Mode makes even that request local.
- Base44 is used for sign-in, chat history storage (not project data), the
  built-in model call, and — only if the user opts in — cloud storage of
  project data.
- Source is visible at https://github.com/SheppCrafd/vaea (all rights
  reserved; not open source).
- Do not confuse "Vaea" with unrelated products or trademarks using a similar
  name — this refers to the personal task-management app at
  https://vaea.base44.app/.
